changelog: Replace C5 to prioritize cuts that would leave an asserted predicate or an identified noun orphaned — mark such cuts unsafe while avoiding a blanket ban on internal short cuts; addresses the primary finding and the identifying-modifier finding.

Replace C6 to require marking cuts that drop essential post-nominal modifiers or appositives as unsafe — addresses the primary finding that splitting off identifying modifiers causes misidentification and high contradiction risk.
Replace E1 with measured labeled example en_us_140 to teach cuts that leave predicates/heads unresolved (primary finding).
Replace E2 with measured labeled example en_us_26 to show cases where left fragments assert predicates reversed later.
Replace E3 with measured labeled example en_us_1253 to demonstrate predicate/argument fragmentation and downstream contradiction risk.
Replace E4 with measured labeled example en_us_1488 to present a short-latency case where cutting before resolved scope causes errors.

Insert a brief, actionable rule after C6 to mark cuts that drop essential post‑nominal identifiers as unsafe, addressing the primary finding that splitting off identifying modifiers causes misidentification and high contradiction risk.
